headline: Argentina Stocks Bounce While Peso Hits New Low
summary: The Merval index rose 0.4% to 81,794 following a previous sell-off, while the Argentine peso weakened to 1,552 per dollar, reaching its lowest level in at least a year.
why: Tracking Argentine financial markets provides insights into local equity performance and currency depreciation pressures amidst economic reforms.

impacts.name: Argentine peso
impacts.why: A falling exchange rate indicates continued depreciation of the peso against the US dollar.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: Persistent economic uncertainty and ongoing currency depreciation pushed the peso to a multi-month low, even as local stocks recovered slightly from a prior sell-off.
